scenario_description: Elena has a confirmed three-day substitute assignment at Northgate Community School and initially plans to drive. Separate messages establish that school parking will cost $11 per day, while a direct bus from Clintonville costs $4 round trip and arrives with enough time for check-in. At event4, the route looks promising but it is still unclear whether Elena can enter through the entrance near the bus stop, so intervention remains premature. Event5 confirms that substitutes may use that entrance with their school badges, making the opportunity sufficiently observable: the agent can connect the assignment times, fares, bus schedule, and entrance instructions to prepare a concrete three-day transit plan that could save Elena $21 in parking fees. Event6 adds urgency by warning that the garage may fill early, but bus planning was already justified at event5.

parameter.subject: June local-bus fare information
parameter.body: The standard local-bus fare remains $2 per ride during June 2026. Riders may pay when boarding with a contactless bank card or mobile wallet. A round trip with no transfers costs $4, and no advance pass is required.

parameter.subject: June 15-17 substitute assignment confirmed
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed at Northgate Community School, 1550 Cleveland Avenue, for Monday, June 15 through Wednesday, June 17, 2026. Please report by 7:45 AM each day. Coverage ends at 3:40 PM, and you will remain at Northgate throughout each day. Bring your school identification badge, laptop, and usual classroom kit.

parameter.subject: Parking during your June 15-17 assignment
parameter.body: Our free visitor lot will be unavailable during your three-day assignment because of summer construction. Substitutes who drive may use the Cleveland Avenue garage for $11 per day. The garage does not allow in-and-out parking, and parking charges are not reimbursed by the school.

parameter.subject: Weekday Route 4 trips from Clintonville to Northgate
parameter.body: Route 4 provides direct weekday service from the North High Street and North Broadway stop to the East 11th Avenue and Cleveland Avenue stop. The 6:58 AM bus is scheduled to arrive at 7:24 AM, about a four-minute walk from Northgate Community School's west entrance. Return trips leave that stop at 3:52 PM and 4:12 PM. No transfer is needed in either direction.

parameter.subject: West entrance access for your Northgate assignment
parameter.body: For June 15-17, the west entrance beside the East 11th Avenue bus stop will open at 7:15 AM. Substitutes may enter there by showing a current district school identification badge, then proceed inside to the main office for check-in. You do not need a separate access request.

parameter.subject: Reduced garage capacity June 15-17
parameter.body: Only half of the Cleveland Avenue garage will be available from June 15 through June 17 because of an overlapping community event. The daily rate remains $11, but spaces may fill by 7:20 AM. Drivers should allow extra time to locate other paid parking if the garage is full.
